Trachypithecus vetulus nestor or Puple faced langur, in Athurugiriya, near Colombo, Sri Lanka
The purple-faced langur also known as the purple-faced leaf monkey is a species of monkey that is endemic to Sri Lanka.
This is a monkey that typically found in Sri Lanka and it was called Langur
